paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: Different Audio-Language models’ performance on MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance of different audio-language models on two datasets, MMAU and MMAR. The horizontal axis displays the model names: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, presented in that order. The vertical axis represents accuracy, labeled in percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, and tick labels at intervals of 10. Two sets of bars are presented for each model; the first set, in blue, represents MMAU performance, and the second set, in purple, represents MMAR performance. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, the MMAU bar has an approximate height of 50%, while the MMAR bar reaches approximately 30%. Audio-Reasoner exhibits MMAU accuracy around 60%, with MMAR accuracy at approximately 35%. Finally, Qwen-2.5-Omni shows MMAU accuracy of approximately 65%, and MMAR accuracy of approximately 58%. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation based on dataset.
